# Feature: Feature Showcase

## Overview
Create interactive demonstrations of key product features that help potential customers understand the platform's capabilities and benefits for their specific industry.

## User Stories

1. Feature Navigation
   - As a potential customer
   - I want to browse through key features
   - So that I can understand the full scope of the product

2. Interactive Demos
   - As a potential customer
   - I want to see the product in action
   - So that I can visualize using it in my business

3. Industry-Specific Examples
   - As a service business owner
   - I want to see examples from my industry
   - So that I can understand how it fits my needs

4. Feature Comparison
   - As a potential customer
   - I want to compare features across pricing tiers
   - So that I can choose the right plan

5. Mobile Preview
   - As a mobile-first business
   - I want to see how the app works on mobile
   - So that I can ensure it fits my workflow

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create interactive feature demonstration components
- [ ] Build industry-specific demo data sets
- [ ] Implement feature comparison matrix
- [ ] Create mobile app preview system
- [ ] Build animated workflow demonstrations
- [ ] Implement video integration for complex features
- [ ] Add contextual CTAs within demos
- [ ] Create preview environment for live demos
- [ ] Implement usage analytics
- [ ] Add keyboard navigation support

## Acceptance Criteria
- All demos work across major browsers
- Interactive elements are accessible
- Industry examples load dynamically
- Mobile previews render correctly
- Videos load without impacting performance
- Feature matrix is easy to understand
- Analytics track demo engagement
- Responsive on all device sizes

## Technical Notes
- Use Stimulus for interactive components
- Implement proper lazy loading
- Use CSS transitions for animations
- Cache demo data appropriately
- Use WebM and MP4 for videos
- Implement proper ARIA labels

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Landing Page feature
- Core branding guidelines
- Product screenshots and demos
